notes.discovery-design-handoff: This looks ready for the Design phase. Start a Design session to research the codebase and develop the approach.
notes.design-execute-standard: The approach is ready. Create the plan with the create-plan skill, review it with the review-plan skill, and once the human has approved it execute it task-by-task (the execute-task skill per task, sequential with opportunistic parallel dispatch).
notes.design-execute-epic: The epic approach and decomposition are ready. Start execution at the child-plan level: the create-plan skill for a child plan, then the execute-task skill per task.
